caption: The drawing depicts a decorative iron window grille featuring vertical and horizontal bars intersected by ornate scrollwork designs located at various points of intersection and along the edges. The grille appears slightly convex, projecting outward from the wall, and is composed of black or dark gray iron. The background shows light sketching in blue and brownish-orange hues, suggesting a wall or shadow behind the grille. The overall image is rendered on a beige or off-white paper, and the name "Harry Mann Waddell" is printed in the lower right corner.
title: Iron Grille at Window: Restoration Drawing
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
